verses.1: Strengthen yourselves, O sons of Benjamin, from within Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet at Tekoa, and raise a signal over the fortress, for evil has been seen from the north and a great destruction.
verses.2: The beauty and majesty of Daughter Zion have been taken away.
verses.3: To her will come shepherds and their flocks, and they will pitch tents around her, each one pasturing with his own hand.
verses.4: Prepare for her a holy war, rise and let us ascend at midday. Woe to us, for the day has turned, for the shadows of the evening are falling.
verses.5: Rise and let us ascend at night and destroy her foundations.
verses.6: For thus says the LORD of Hosts: Cut down her trees and pour out against Jerusalem strength. She is a false city, all of her is a stronghold within her.
verses.7: As a spring dries up from its water, so she has dried up her evil. Violence and oppression will be heard in her, continually on my face, pain and punishment.
verses.8: Be disciplined, Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you, lest I make you a land not inhabited.
verses.9: Thus says the LORD: Pluck like grapes, pluck like grapes, the remnant of Israel. Return like the gatherer to his vineyard.
verses.10: To whom shall I speak and who will listen? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear. Behold, the word of the LORD has become to them a reproach, which they do not want.
verses.11: And I have filled my anger and held it back, but I have not finished them. I will pour it out on infants outside, on the assembly of young men together, for a man and a woman will be taken together, the old with the full of days.
verses.12: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their women alike. For I will stretch out my hand against those who live on this land, says the LORD.
verses.13: For from the smallest to the greatest, they have all broken the covenant. From the prophet to the priest, they have all done falsehood.
verses.14: And they have healed the wound of my people in a light way, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.
verses.15: They are put to shame because they have abandoned me, but they do not feel ashamed. They do not know their disgrace. Therefore, they will fall into their ruin and be destroyed at the time of my judgment, says the LORD.
verses.16: Thus says the LORD: Stand on the roads and look, and ask for the ancient paths, where is the good way? Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they say, "We will not go."
verses.17: I have set watchers over you, listen to the sound of the trumpet. But they say, "We will not listen."
verses.18: Therefore, let the nations hear and let the shepherds know what is in them.
verses.19: Listen, earth. Behold, I am bringing evil to this people, the fruit of their rebellion, for they did not listen to my words, and they despised my teaching.
verses.20: What is this to me, that incense comes from Sheba and a fragrant offering from a distant land? Your sacrifices are not acceptable, and your offerings are not pleasing to me.
verses.21: Therefore, thus says the LORD: I will give this people a stumbling block, and they will all fall into it, fathers and sons together, neighbor and friend, and they will be lost.
verses.22: Thus says the LORD: Behold, a people is coming from the land of the north, and a great nation is rising from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.23: Bow and spear they will hold. Hardened are they, and they will not have mercy. Their voice will be like the sea roaring, and they will ride on horses, drawn up like a man for battle, against you, Daughter Zion.
verses.24: We have heard their sound. Our hands have gone limp. Pain has gripped us, like a woman in childbirth.
verses.25: Do not go out into the field, and do not walk on the road, for a sword is the enemy's terror all around.
verses.26: Daughter of my people, put on sackcloth and roll in dust. Make for yourself a mourning for a beloved, a mourning of bitterness, for suddenly the spoiler will come upon us.
verses.27: I have given you a trial among the people who have been tried, and you will know it when I test their ways.
verses.28: They are all corrupters, going along crookedly. All of them are destroyers.
verses.29: A bellows blowing fire has been emptied of its dust. The refiner refines in vain, and the wicked are not cut off.
verses.30: Silver has been rejected. They are called worthless, for the LORD has rejected them.

notes:
Notes
- v. 13: "they have all done falsehood" — the Hebrew uses "they have all done deceit" (כֻּלּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר), referring to both prophets and priests.
- v. 30: "Silver has been rejected" — the Hebrew uses "rejected" (נִמְאָס), a direct reference to their rejection by the LORD.
